_dataFloorNote: dataFloor = first week a metric has real data. Weeks before it are skipped, not pushed as 0, so the board shows a blank instead of a false flat line. Quick Fix line items first appear in Jobber 2026-01-20; CallRail's first call is 2026-04-30.

phone_calls.label: Phone Calls
phone_calls.note: CallRail has no calls before 2026-04-30 and only went fully live the week of 05-18; earlier weeks would push a false 0

missed_calls.label: Missed Calls
missed_calls.note: created 2026-07-26 via UI (public API has no KPI-create); goal <=2/wk, orientation lte. answered==false on inbound calls

tmcp_cancellations.label: TMCP Cancellations
tmcp_cancellations.note: fed by the 'TMCP Churned' client tag, not by job endAt (endAt stays in the future after a silent cancellation, which is why the job-derived version computed 0 every week). Jobber's Tag type is {id,label} with no timestamp, so weekly churn cannot be backfilled — each run snapshots the tag count to data/tmcp-tag-snapshots.json and pushes the week-over-week delta. Baseline recorded 2026-07-26 at 20 tagged; first real number lands the following week.

past_due_invoices.label: Past-Due Invoices
past_due_invoices.note: count of past_due invoices; dollar total pushed as a note
